newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's long-term rates to fall further - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Spain's long-term rates to fall further - Treasury.

text.p: The downtrend in Spain's long-term interest rates is likely to last throughout the process of European convergence, Spain's Treasury Director Jaime Caruana said on Wednesday.

"The (EMU) convergence process is slow and it is pushing down our spread over Bunds. This process will continue," Caruana told reporters after a conference in Madrid on the euro, the future European single currency.
Yesterday, the Bank of Spain Governor Luis Angel Rojo said that the decline in long term rates was almost over.
